subject.title: Expose structured progress metrics in hook events for plugin-based live progress cards

question: Should OpenClaw add a producer-owned structured progress metrics contract to plugin hook events, and what runtime source owns `stepTotal`, `percent`, ETA, and terminal metrics?
rationale: The missing API surface is source-reproducible, but the public Plugin SDK semantics and progress source of truth are product/API decisions that automation should not invent.

options.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
options.body: Add optional metrics only where the runtime can produce authoritative values, document unknown fields as absent, and cover the relevant producers with focused tests.

options.title: Keep hooks unchanged
options.body: Leave plugins to derive progress from lifecycle and tool events, accepting text-only or phase-only live cards where numeric progress is unknowable.

options.title: Design a separate progress event
options.body: Create a dedicated progress event or projection instead of attaching percentages to existing tool and terminal hook payloads.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
recommendation.body: Add optional metrics only where the runtime can produce authoritative values, document unknown fields as absent, and cover the relevant producers with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior hook payload correlation work is the closest current history trail for deciding this public hook contract.
